meta.title: CRAVE LAB — Modern Minimal Print Menu

div.p: Crispy Flaky Parathas • Fire-Smoked Fillings • House Slaw

article.p: Crispy fried chicken tenders tossed in ghost chili oil, tangy dill pickles, hot honey drizzle & cheddar melt wrapped in buttered flaky paratha.
Charcoal-tandoori chicken morsels simmered in velvety makhani glaze, red pickled shallots, fresh coriander cream & crispy sev crunch.
Shredded oak-smoked beef brisket, bourbon molasses BBQ sauce, crispy tobacco onions, charred jalapenos & smoked gouda cheese.
Grilled cottage cheese cubes in spiced yoghurt marinade, roasted bell peppers, fresh mint chutney relish & pomegranate crunch.
Sliced herb-roasted chicken breast, sautéed wild mushrooms, black truffle aioli, baby rocket leaves & melted parmesan crisps.
Double flame-grilled lamb seekh skewers, cumin-spiced yoghurt drizzle, crispy spiced potatoes & shredded green chili slaw.

div.span: All rolls prepared fresh to order. Please alert our staff to any sesame, dairy, or gluten allergies.

div.p: Crispy Lacy Edges • 100% Angus Chuck • Griddled Brioche

article.p: Two 3oz smash patties with ultra-crispy edges, double American cheese, dill pickles, grilled sweet onions & secret yellow Crave sauce.
Paper-thin sweet Vidalia onions pressed deep into sizzling beef patties, double melted cheddar, mustard relish & toasted potato bun.
Three crispy smash patties, hardwood smoked bacon strips, warm maple-bacon onion jam, smoked provolone & garlic butter drip.
Double Angus beef, butter-roasted cremini mushrooms, aged Swiss Gruyere, black winter truffle aioli & crispy shallot straw.
Double smash beef crusted in habanero salt, pepper jack cheese, pickled jalapeño coins, roasted serrano paste & fire mayo.
Double beef smash, golden beer-battered onion ring, sharp Wisconsin cheddar, smokey hickory BBQ sauce & garlic herb spread.

div.span: Certified Halal beef. Gluten-free lettuce wraps available upon request.

div.p: Handcrafted Thick Cuts • Southern Fried Bird • Plant Masterpieces

article.p: 24-hour buttermilk soaked chicken thigh double-dredged for maximum crunch, Nashville spice dusting, sweet honey butter, house pickles & creamy slaw.
7oz prime beef patty, thick cut smoked pork belly or beef bacon, melted double gouda, beer mustard, tomato relish & crisp iceberg.
Crispy fried chicken breast drenched in sticky garlic gochujang glaze, house fermented kimchi slaw, toasted sesame seeds & kewpie mayo.
Pure Wagyu beef patty, black garlic glaze, melted taleggio cheese, truffle-infused caramelized onions & baby spinach on toasted milk bun.
Thick griddled Cypriot halloumi slab, avocado mash, roasted red peppers, balsamic onion jam & garlic herb labneh on brioche.
Prime beef patty, smoked Monterey Jack cheese, crispy onion frizzles, Texas mesquite BBQ sauce & cool house herb buttermilk ranch.

div.span: CRAVELAB.MENU // CUSTOMIZE: EXTRA PATTY +$4.00 • TRUFFLE DIP +$2.50
Buns freshly baked daily by artisan bakers. Vegan potato bun substitution available free.

div.p: Heavyweight Combos • Seasoned Waffle Fries • Signature Sauces

article.p: Includes The OG Double Smash Burger, large golden seasoned skin-on fries, 3 mozzarella bites, house Crave dipping sauce & cold craft soda.
4 colossal buttermilk fried chicken tenders dusted in fiery Nashville spice, grilled Texas toast, pickle spears, waffle fries & 2 dipping sauces.
Pick any 2 gourmet paratha rolls, accompanied by spiced masala fries, minted cucumber yoghurt dip, pickled shallots & 2 fountain sodas.
Crispy popcorn chicken, 4 mac & cheese bites, loaded chili cheese fries, onion rings, truffle aioli & garlic herb mayo tubs.
2 Double Smash Burgers, 2 Crispy Buttermilk Birds, 2 giant loaded fries, 12 crispy tenders, 4 dipping sauces & 4 canned drinks.
6 crispy halloumi fries with honey chili drizzle, sweet potato fries, falafel bites, tzatziki dip & toasted zaatar flatbread.

article.p: Single Smash Burger or Classic Roll + Hot Fries + Fountain Drink. Guaranteed served in under 7 minutes for your busy work lunch.
Choice of any 2 Burgers or Rolls + 1 Shared Giant Truffle Loaded Fries + 2 Gourmet Milkshakes (Nutella Crunch / Biscoff).
Double Oklahoma Smash + 3 Crispy Nashville Tenders + Cheese-smothered waffle fries + 1 Energy drink or Shake.

3 Double Smashes, 3 Loaded Rolls, 24 Bone-in Crispy Wings, 2 XL seasoned fries & 6 dipping pots with 2L soda.
